A sync fetches only what's new since the: A sync fetches only what's new since the last one (the first fetches every race since you joined, 90 days at a time, which takes a minute or two), and your ratings and iRacing's totals again. iRacing limits how often its API is called: when the limit is reached, the sync waits and carries on.
Your races, ratings and totals are kept: Your races, ratings and totals are kept in the iRacing folder of the app's local data, so the tab shows them at once and a sync only fetches what's new.
